summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for coordinating multi-agent long tasks where a lead plans dependencies, dispatches and reviews node work, and tracks progress through persisted task logs plus board/status views.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The repository is a DeepSeek Harness plugin centered on coordinating multi-agent task execution: the lead creates DAG-based plans, dispatches nodes, and reviews results, while members execute tasks and a reconciler/runtime loop keeps progress moving across restarts. Evidence shows task truth stored in an append-only workspace log with snapshot/inbox views and UI/status surfaces, so the primary user-facing purpose is orchestration and planning execution rather than generic coding or file-only tooling.
